text:
Sam (AE): heads up — Sylvan (prospect) just pushed an enterprise checklist. CISO wants BYO-KMS attestation + TLS egress to their VPC and a committed pricing quote for a 6mo Dedicated pool. asking for an exec sync if we can't answer today :grimacing:
Jordan (SE): I started the POC env this morning but peering request got stuck w/ network team. need their CIDR + contact at Sylvan.
Priya (Sales Eng): pricing note: if they commit to 8 GPUs for 6mo we can offer 12% off list and reduced overage rates. need to confirm model profile (llama-70b or mix).
Sam (AE): Tara (Customer CTO) shared their preferred models: mix of open models + some finetuned variants. Raj — can you join if this goes to exec?
Nina (Security): we can support BYO-KMS via our Private deployment (VPC + KMS integration). will need: 1) KMS attestation doc signed 2) network diagrams showing egress flows 3) SOC2 + any sector-specific addenda. I can draft answers for their security questionnaire.
Eli (Infra): timeline: Dedicated capacity requires a 10 business day lead for GPU provisioning in that region + peering config. if they accept our Dedicated pricing we can prioritize.
Sam (AE): they want a timeline today — can we say 2 weeks for full POC if peering + KMS creds arrive within 48h?
Jordan (SE): yes assuming no custom kernel work. also need to confirm whether they want prefix caching enabled.
Nina (Security): draft for questionnaire: "We support customer-managed keys (BYO-KMS) via industry-standard KMIP and cloud KMS integrations. Keys never leave customer KMS; logs and audit events available on request." i'll paste a full canned response in a sec.
Priya (Sales Eng): I'll prepare the 6mo committed quote and a fallback monthly offer. Sam, can you get the exact model mix from Tara so I can price correctly?
Sam (AE): @Tara (Customer CTO) can you drop the model list + networking contact?
Tara (Customer CTO): sharing now — sent to Sam via email. networking contact is matthew@syvanlabs.com. model list: mix: open-70b, finetuned-7b-lite.
Sam (AE): thanks! forwarding to Jordan + Eli.
Raj (VP Sales): I can jump on a 30m call at 15:00 PT today to clear exec questions. bring the quote and security draft.
deploy-bot: created p-42876-poc-cluster in staging (id: cluster-7f9). logs: https://internal.deploys/cluster-7f9 :robot_face:
Jordan (SE): putting a placeholder on my calendar for 14:30 to validate peering once matthew confirms.
Nina (Security): paste of canned answer below (to reuse in questionnaire):
```
Q: Does Redwood support customer-managed keys?
A: Yes. Redwood Private and Dedicated deployments support BYO-KMS. We integrate with AWS KMS/GCP KMS/Azure KeyVault and KMIP-compliant HSMs. Customer keys remain in their KMS; Redwood stores only references. We provide audit logs of key usage on request and can assist with attestation documentation.
```
Sam (AE): plan -> (1) Priya sends draft committed quote by 13:00 PT (2) Sam collects network/KMS details from Sylvan by 13:30 (3) Jordan/Eli validate peering & capacity 14:30 (4) Raj joins 15:00 exec bridge to finalize. status updates here please. :thumbsup:
Eli (Infra): noted. if they want dedicated in eu-west it adds a 2 day hardware allocation delay; will confirm for their chosen region.
Priya (Sales Eng): quote draft shared in DM to Sam, flagging model mix rates and recommended cache profile.
Sam (AE): thanks everyone. will post final confirm or blocker flags before the 14:30 check.
